import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
import unittest
from unittest import mock
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src import service
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_batch(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [])

    def test_insert_update_and_normalization(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "old@x.com", "Old")
        result = import_contacts(c, [
            {"email": "  New@Example.COM ", "name": "  Nina  "},
            {"email": "old@x.com", "name": "Old"},  # unchanged name still counts as updated
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("new@example.com", "Nina"), ("old@x.com", "Old")])

    def test_existing_email_updates_name(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "a@b.com", "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, [{"email": "A@B.com", "name": "Alicia"}]),
                         {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b.com", "Alicia")])

    def test_rejections_leave_db_unchanged(self):
        bad_batches = [
            ["not a dict"],
            [{"email": "a@b.com"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "A", "extra": 1}],
            [{"email": 1, "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": None}],
            [{"email": "ab.com", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@b@c.com", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "@b.com", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a b@c.com", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "   "}],
            [{"email": "x@y.com", "name": "X"}, {"email": " X@Y.com ", "name": "Dup"}],
            [{"email": "x@y.com", "name": "X"}, {"email": "bad", "name": "Y"}],
        ]
        for batch in bad_batches:
            c = fresh()
            add_contact(c, "keep@k.com", "Keep")
            with self.subTest(batch=batch):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(c, batch)
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("keep@k.com", "Keep")])

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back_whole_batch(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "keep@k.com", "Keep")
        real_put = service.put_contact
        calls = {"n": 0}

        def failing_put(connection, email, name):
            calls["n"] += 1
            if calls["n"] == 2:
                raise sqlite3.OperationalError("simulated failure")
            return real_put(connection, email, name)

        with mock.patch.object(service, "put_contact", side_effect=failing_put):
            with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.OperationalError):
                import_contacts(c, [
                    {"email": "keep@k.com", "name": "Changed"},
                    {"email": "new@n.com", "name": "New"},
                ])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("keep@k.com", "Keep")])


class ApiImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_envelope_and_summary(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "A"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(c, {"contacts": [
            {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "A2"}, {"email": "c@d.com", "name": "C"}]}),
            {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b.com", "A2"), ("c@d.com", "C")])

    def test_malformed_envelopes(self):
        c = fresh()
        for payload in [[], {}, {"contacts": []  , "x": 1}, {"rows": []}, {"contacts": {}}, {"contacts": None}]:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
